vulnerability_title: Contributions not reset after purchase allows infinite reward claims

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: recordPurchase computes each contributor's share from _contributions[contributor][collection].amount, but nothing in the contract ever resets that amount. The same contribution earns a share of every later purchase in the collection.
patterns_found: contribution amount never reset after a purchase

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: old contributions earn shares in every later purchase
